note: Every Météo-France ground station of the box whose latest 6-minute wind observation is at most `max_age_hours` old, strongest mean wind first. The wind is measured at 10 m where the station stands: a summit (`alt_m`) or a sheltered valley can differ much from the places around. `age_minutes` is calculated by Vigie. Not for safety.
attribution: Source: Météo-France, observations infrahoraires 6 min (https://portail-api.meteofrance.fr/web/fr/api/PaquetObs, Licence Ouverte 2.0), dated as in the answer (measured_at, UTC); the choice of the station, its distance, its age and the relative wind are calculated by Vigie | Source: Météo-France, file 'POSTES_MF.csv' (Licence Ouverte 2.0), names and altitudes of the open ground stations
